ambiguous_front_case_partition_envelope.basis: For positive EA in the uniform-row formula n*Cg>=1; both partitions have row capacity at least min(Zi). Each demand sums raw lateral port magnitudes before cancellation, using the worse of the two wood receivers. Fe90 and min(raw six-mode P)/5 lower-bound the angle-dependent pure-lateral references.
limits: Conditional pure-lateral control only; local moments, axial transfer, splitting, geometry, delivered fit and complete connection qualification remain separate.
ambiguous_front_case_partition_envelope.scope: Two possible lateral-row partitions [1,1] or [2]; no row partition or Cg is adopted.

base_rows.scope: Four base joints; one physical rear-foot fastener per side, two front fasteners per side. Full connection and geometry duties remain separate.

cleat_local_references.comparison_scope: Both use Fe parallel 5600 psi and perpendicular 3150 psi. Legacy optimized blocks credit 23.8 mm; current equal halves use 25.4 mm. The difference is not a group-factor or material improvement.
cleat_local_references.pressure_construction: Force-and-first-moment-preserving, equal-half piecewise-constant pressure reference; not actual contact pressure.

symbolic_identity.N_minus_D: sum(m**j for j=2..2n-1) + R*sum(m**j for j=1..2n, j not in {n,n+1})
symbolic_identity.conclusion: N-D is nonnegative; both sums are empty at n=1, giving equality. Therefore n*Cg=N/D>=1 for every positive-EA uniform-row equation case.

NDS_positive_EA_algebra.domain: n>=1 integer, 0<m<1, 0<R_EA<=1 for positive finite member EA and positive uniform row pitch
NDS_positive_EA_algebra.identity: N-D = sum(m^j, j=2..2n-1) + R*sum(m^j, j=1..2n, j not in {n,n+1}) >= 0
NDS_positive_EA_algebra.implication: n*Cg>=1 for every positive-EA uniform-row case; hence row capacity n*Cg*min(Z_i)>=min(Z_i). For n=1, both sums are empty and n*Cg=1.
NDS_positive_EA_algebra.reduction: n*Cg = N/D, where N=m*(1+R)*sum(m^j, j=0..2n-1), D=m+m^(2n)+R*m^n*(1+m)

conditional_TR12_material_scenario.direction_independent_wood_Fe: existing TR12 helper at 90 degrees to grain, G=0.50

limits: All 15 set partitions are treated as a superset for a conditional algebraic envelope; no partition is asserted admissible under the geometric NDS row and stagger rules.

The capacity lower bound applies only if each actual row is within NDS Eq. 11.3-1 uniform-row applicability and has positive member EA. This result does not establish row alignment, pitch, stagger merge, even/odd interpretation, actual EA, or an actual Cg.

Each hypothetical row demand is the sum of raw per-port lateral force magnitudes for its member axes. This bounds lateral projections without cancellation but excludes axial actions, moments/free couples, splitting/net section, fitting/steel resistance and redistribution.

A below-one partition envelope is only the conditional pure-lateral screen under the stated unadopted TR12 scenario; it is not universal whole-joint capacity, actual material acceptance, or a climbing/fabrication release. An index at or above one is inconclusive, not a failure.
A below-one upper bound is only a conditional pure-lateral mode screen across the positive-EA Cg domain under the stated scenario. It is not actual capacity, actual Cg, or complete-joint acceptance.
A bound at or above one is inconclusive and is not called a failure; changing actual EA cannot raise the formula capacity above n*min(Z), but the material scenario itself is unadopted.

Current selected D/Dr and thread-bearing lengths are analytical piecewise scenarios; delivered bolt identity, thread/root extent, steel grade/Fu, wood species/grade/moisture, and physical contact have not been observed.

Moments and free couples, axial capture, splitting/net section, fitting/steel strength, row assignment outside the robust-merged subset, multi-media header groups, and all complete-joint interactions remain unresolved.

method.EA_domain: positive main and side member EA; the existing exact two-fastener uniform-row bound is 0.5 <= Cg <= 1, hence n*Cg >= 1 for n=2
method.TR12_six_mode_helper: candidate13_tr12_yield_subcheck._single_shear_modes -> existing fea.dowel_yield.single_shear; no new capacity equation implemented
method.TR12_wood_Fe_helper: candidate13_tr12_yield_subcheck._fe_theta_psi at 90 degrees; reuses source-pinned NDS 2024 Fe(θ) equation helper
method.capacity_bound: For each row, capacity >= min(Z_i) because n*Cg*min(Z_i) >= min(Z_i); compare sum of all receiver-port lateral-force magnitudes against this lower capacity.
method.demand_definition: Sum over every raw wood receiver boundary-port action of the magnitude of force perpendicular to its own shaft axis; this includes row and transverse lateral components and avoids vector cancellation.
method.direction_independent_Z: Compute each shaft's minimum six-mode Z with wood at Fe perpendicular to grain (G=0.50), selected current analytical D/Dr, current modeled member bearing lengths, Fyb=45 ksi, and the existing unadopted steel Fe derived from Fu=370 MPa.

noncleat_rows.scope: Nominal frozen axes and current modeled force directions. The initial 40 factory-role pairs were not the complete NDS row partition.

shared_header_symmetry.schema_scope: source-bound symmetric NDS double-shear applicability diagnostic only

two_media_singleton_lateral_references.limits: Existing conditional single-fastener lateral references at nominal singleton Cg=1; not adjusted whole-connection capacity.

ordinary_EYM_moment_scope.applicability_boundary: A P/Z reference can address a lateral single-shear force when member topology, material inputs, effective diameter, end/edge/spacing, load direction, and group applicability are established. It does not cover independent applied connection couples, axial capture, torsion, or complete-joint/group effects. Current geometry/material conformity, Cg/Cdelta, and whole-joint acceptance remain unresolved. The observation here corrects the blanket inference that every nonzero elastic bearing free couple must be an independent duty beyond EYM; it does not certify P/Z applicability or capacity for these current connections.

current_action_scope.body_applied_loads_scope: The selected shaft-body loads are point forces with no explicit moment_xyz_nmm. Their lever arms can produce a body-load moment about the shaft origin; that is not an applied end couple.

maximum_saved_local_bearing_free_couple_.interpretation: These local values are pressure-field reaction couples. Their magnitude alone does not identify an independent externally applied couple demand.

current_action_scope.separate_axial_capture: Axial end-capture forces are nonzero and are not covered by lateral P/Z. Maximum absolute captured force is 329.3559929227586 N on the rear wood-wood axes and 53.920612680701836 N on the cleat plywood-sawn axes.
current_action_scope.wood_bearing_couple_scope: The saved host_lateral_couple_at_interval_center is the first moment of the force-and-couple-preserving wood pressure field about that host interval center. The shaft receives the opposite contact wrench. These are local bearing reactions, not additional independently applied shaft-end couples.

known_answer.internal_yield_moment_inputs: M_s = M_m = F_yb D^3/6, both positive
known_answer.loading: pure single-shear lateral reference P; no independently imposed connection couple input
known_answer.meaning: The pure-P yield reference contains internal bolt-bending moments; it is not a pure-force/no-moment beam model. This fixture does not establish that an independent external couple is covered by Z.

ordinary_EYM_moment_scope.method_basis: TR12/NDS single-shear yield modes model ordinary induced dowel bending and bearing couples while returning lateral force reference Z. The equations include internal dowel yield moments, e.g. M_s and M_m, in modes IIIm, IIIs, and IV. A P/Z comparison does not require the ultimate bearing-pressure moment distribution to equal the current elastic FE pressure distribution.
ordinary_EYM_moment_scope.status: nonzero moment alone does not disqualify EYM P/Z

algebra_controls.proof: For positive Z1,Z2, singleton capacity Z1+Z2 >= min(Z1,Z2); merged n=2 row capacity >= min(Z1,Z2) because n*Cg>=1. Also (d1+d2)/min(Zi) >= max(di/Zi).

limits: This is a partition-envelope component control, not a selected row partition, actual Cg, actual capacity, or complete-joint pass.
The envelope is limited to two-pin, two-media wood/steel groups, where the two possible partitions are [1,1] or [2]. It is not extended to three-media shared headers or four-pin groups.

The positive-EA bound and angle-independent Z are conditional on the model's uniform two-fastener row equation and the stated unadopted material scenario. Actual EA, species/grade/moisture, steel grade/Fe, delivered bolt/root, fit, and contact are unknown.

Moments/free couples, axial capture, splitting/net section, fitting capacity, force redistribution and all complete-joint interactions remain unresolved. A value at or above one would be inconclusive, not a failure.

method.capacity_case_1: Two singleton rows [1,1]: per-fastener lower bounds Z1 and Z2, aggregate lower bound Z1+Z2.
method.capacity_case_2: One merged row [2]: for positive EA, n*Cg>=1, so capacity lower bound is min(Z1,Z2).
method.demand: Sum of every raw receiver-port lateral-force magnitude, which upper-bounds individual and group force projections without cancellation.
method.direction_independent_Z: Existing pinned TR12 helper at wood Fe perpendicular to grain (G=.50), current selected D/Dr and member lengths, Fyb=45 ksi and unadopted Fu=370 MPa steel Fe scenario.
method.four_pin_limit: The two-pin envelope does not resolve multirow assignments for four-pin top-center groups; their existing pairwise merge graph remains unresolved.
method.partition_envelope: Minimum lower capacity across [1,1] and [2] is min(Z1,Z2); no actual partition or Cg is selected.

rear_rows.scope: Per-row lateral component only; no connection-wide Cg, capacity or pass.

unresolved: Complete simultaneous connection/group resistance and applicability, including mixed plywood/sawn/steel stacks and unequal steel-side actions.
Exact direction-sensitive/four-axis row assignments remain unadopted; conservative pure-lateral partition envelopes cover the two-media cases. End/edge/spacing/Cdelta applicability remains open.
